name: Modifiers Pack
description: A set of basic Modifier plugins (backgrounds, colors, spacing, effects) for the Modifiers module.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 This module provides an starter set of Modifiers which will be helpful for basic and common modification use cases. Currently the following Modifiers are included:

 
 Absolute Height Modifier 
 Colors Modifier 
 Corners Modifier 
 Custom Colors Modifier 
 Custom Linear Gradient Modifier 
 Custom Radial Gradient Modifier 
 Fonts Modifier 
 Hide Modifier 
 HTML Font Size Modifier 
 Image Background Modifier 
 Image FX Modifier 
 Linear Gradient Modifier 
 Padding Modifier 
 Parallax Background Modifier 
 Radial Gradient Modifier 
 Relative Height Modifier 
 Shadow Modifier 
 Video Background Modifier 
 
 Each of the modules can have its own set of requirements and dependencies. Look at their respective readme and info files.
